snippet.title: CARIMARA: Beneath the forlorn limbs — Release Date Trailer
snippet.description:
Wishlist on Steam: https://s.team/a/3570370

CARIMARA: Beneath the forlorn limbs launches on October 6, 2025.

A mute little thing with borrowed magic. A house that murmurs back. Ask wrong, and you might wake something that remembers your name.
